quotedFileContent.value:
Aristocrats of the old world bring what wealth they can with them, and start with 10,000 gold. In addition, they bring civilization, rule of law, and a certain sophistication not found among the serfs or merchants. Only Aristocrats may own land, being granted a charter from the king. They are able to levy rents and taxes against those who wish to use this land. A wise Aristocrat can enjoy growing wealth, while a foolish one may soon be forced to beg for his daily bread, or even worse, work for it.
	Aristocrats are granted an estate registered with the king and approved by the town council. There are strict zoning regulations because protected land is scarce. Only 1 merchant may operate effectively on each parcel of land. As the town grows, more parcels may become available. Aristocrats may come to any agreement they like with merchants. After merchants have been established, it is very difficult to tear down their structure and build a new facility, so it is better to acquire more land…
